caption: The drawing shows a flat iron stand with a pointed, triangular base and a handle extending from one side. The base of the stand is formed by a metal frame with a decorative, symmetrical, openwork pattern inside, consisting of curves and loops. The handle has a rounded end with a large circular hole and additional smaller decorative cutouts. The stand appears to have three short legs supporting it. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving the appearance of metal, and is depicted on a plain, off-white background. There is text in the upper left corner that reads: "Delaware Flat Iron Stand - ME.250 H. Nukill."
title: Flat Iron Stand
